_comment: Edit this file to tune your search. Nothing else needs changing for normal use.

budget._note: Your hard ceiling: rent + condo fees (spese condominiali) + utilities (bollette).
budget._note2: We query the portals up to this rent, then compute the real all-in total below and drop anything over maxTotalPerMonth. Keep this ABOVE your comfort rent so 'spese incluse' bargains still get found.
budget._note3: Electricity + gas + water + internet estimate for a small furnished flat in Genoa. Used when the ad does not say bills are included.
budget._note4: Fallback 'spese condominiali' when the ad does not state them. Genoa averages EUR 70-120/month for a 2-bed.

property._note: Italian ads count TOTAL rooms ('locali'), not bedrooms. 2 bedrooms = 'trilocale' = 3 locali. We handle that conversion automatically.
property._note2: Also keep 3-bedroom flats if they fit the budget - often good value.
property._note3: 'required' | 'preferred' | 'any'. 'required' drops ads explicitly marked NON arredato.

preferences._note: Not filters - these add points to the ranking score so the best matches sort to the top.
preferences._note2: privateOwner scores because you avoid the agency commission (usually 1-2 months rent).

zones._note: Your 12 target areas. 'weight' boosts ranking for the areas you like most - tune freely from 0 to 30.
zones._note2: If an ad has no usable zone name, we accept it when its GPS lands within this radius of one of your areas.
zones._note3: false = also keep strong listings just outside your zones (they appear in a separate 'Nearby' section). Set true to hide them entirely.

idealista._note: Idealista uses DataDome bot protection. headless:false is far more likely to pass. Run 'npm run install-browser' once first.

email._note: Flip to true once you add SMTP credentials to .env - see .env.example. Nothing else needs to change.
email._note2: true = skip sending when nothing new appeared since the last run.

network._note: Politeness delay between requests to the same site. Do not set below 400.
